---
name: 🤖 Hand off to Copilot
about: git-steer opens issues in a repo for what Dependabot can't fix, ready to assign to Copilot.
title: "handoff "
labels: git-steer-handoff
---

Finish the title with the repo, written the way it appears in its GitHub address: the owner, a slash, then the repo name.

git-steer opens issues in that repo for upgrades Dependabot hasn't proposed and for packages with no fixed release. It replies here with links. Open each one and assign it to Copilot. git-steer never assigns them, and changes nothing else.
